PublicSectorStatement.title: Public Sector Statement
PublicSectorStatement.description: An international public-sector accrual financial statement for one fiscal year of a government or public entity, used by the public-sector rule domain to evaluate the IPSASB IPSAS framework (statement composition, cash-flow classification, inventory lower-of-cost measurement, contingent-liability prohibition, non-cash-generating-asset impairment, non-exchange revenue / tax-on-taxable-event recognition, the budget comparison, consolidation eliminations, short-term employee benefits, financial-instrument recognition and the IPSAS 43 right-of-use lease model) and the US GASB statements (the GASB 34 dual government-wide / fund model and its measurement focuses, MD&A, the major-fund criteria, GASB 54 fund-balance classifications, GASB 84 fiduciary fund types, the GASB 87 single lease model, the GASB 96 SBITA model and the GASB 103 budgetary-comparison RSI). The NL-BBV framework is modelled separately by BbvStatement. Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure.

framework.description: Which international public-sector framework this statement is prepared under: the IPSASB IPSAS accrual framework or the US GASB statements.
framework.title: Framework

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the framework applies to: 'global' for IPSAS, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US) for GASB.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

reportingEntity.description: Name of the reporting public-sector entity.
reportingEntity.title: Reporting Entity

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year the statement covers.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the statement is presented in.
currency.title: Currency

consolidated.description: Whether the statement is a consolidated (group) statement, triggering the IPSAS 35 intragroup-elimination rule.
consolidated.title: Consolidated

budgetMadePublic.description: Whether the entity makes its approved budget publicly available, which under IPSAS 24 requires a budget comparison in the complete set of statements (IPSAS 1.21).
budgetMadePublic.title: Budget Made Public

components.description: The component statements present (IPSAS 1.21): financialPosition, financialPerformance, changesInNetAssets, cashFlow, notes, and budgetComparison where applicable.
components.title: Components

cashFlowActivities.description: The cash-flow activity classes the cash-flow statement reports (IPSAS 2.18): operating, investing, financing.
cashFlowActivities.title: Cash Flow Activities

inventories.description: Inventory lines measured per IPSAS 12: ordinary lines at the lower of cost and net realizable value (12.15); distribution lines at the lower of cost and current replacement cost (12.17).

carryingAmount.description: Carrying amount recognized = lower of cost and the applicable comparison value.
carryingAmount.title: Carrying Amount

inventories.title: Inventories

contingentLiabilities.description: Contingent liabilities (IPSAS 19.35): each disclosed only and never recognized on the face of the statements.

recognized.description: Whether recognized on the face — must be false (IPSAS 19.35).
recognized.title: Recognized

contingentLiabilities.title: Contingent Liabilities

impairments.description: Non-cash-generating-asset impairments (IPSAS 21): the carrying amount is reduced to the recoverable service amount, the loss is the difference, and the loss is recognized in surplus or deficit unless the asset is revalued.

carryingAmount.description: Carrying amount after impairment = recoverable service amount.
carryingAmount.title: Carrying Amount

revalued.description: Whether the asset is carried at a revalued amount.
revalued.title: Revalued

impairments.title: Impairments

nonExchangeRevenues.description: Non-exchange revenue inflows (IPSAS 23): a conditioned inflow recognizes the conditioned portion as a liability and the rest as revenue (liability + revenue = amount).

liabilityRecognized.description: Conditioned portion recognized as a liability.
liabilityRecognized.title: Liability Recognized

nonExchangeRevenues.title: Non Exchange Revenues

taxAssets.description: Tax assets (IPSAS 23.59 / 47.36): recognized when the taxable event has occurred.

taxableEventOccurred.description: Whether the taxable event has occurred.
taxableEventOccurred.title: Taxable Event Occurred

taxAssets.title: Tax Assets

budgetComparison.description: The IPSAS 24.14 budget comparison: original and final budget against actuals on a comparable basis, with a material-difference explanation.

basis.description: The basis the comparison is presented on.
basis.title: Basis

actualAmount.description: Actual amount on a comparable basis.
actualAmount.title: Actual Amount

budgetComparison.title: Budget Comparison

intragroupEliminations.description: Consolidation eliminations (IPSAS 35.40): the controlling entity's investment and all intragroup balances and transactions.
intragroupEliminations.title: Intragroup Eliminations

shortTermEmployeeBenefits.description: Short-term employee benefits (IPSAS 39.11): recognized at the undiscounted amount as both a liability and an expense for service rendered.

undiscountedAmount.description: Undiscounted amount expected to be paid.
undiscountedAmount.title: Undiscounted Amount

serviceRendered.description: Whether the related service has been rendered.
serviceRendered.title: Service Rendered

discounted.description: Whether the amount is discounted — must be false for short-term benefits.
discounted.title: Discounted

shortTermEmployeeBenefits.title: Short Term Employee Benefits

financialInstruments.description: Financial assets/liabilities (IPSAS 41.10): recognized when, and only when, the entity becomes party to the contractual provisions.

partyToContract.description: Whether the entity is party to the contractual provisions.
partyToContract.title: Party To Contract

financialInstruments.title: Financial Instruments

leases.description: Leases under IPSAS 43 / GASB 87: a single financing model recognizing a right-of-use asset and a lease liability at present value at commencement; leases with a maximum term of 12 months or less are excluded.

maxTermMonths.description: Maximum possible lease term in months (<=12 invokes the short-term exception).
maxTermMonths.title: Max Term Months

leaseLiability.description: Recognized lease liability at present value (0 for short-term).
leaseLiability.title: Lease Liability

intangibleRouAsset.description: Whether the right-of-use asset is recognized as an intangible asset (GASB 87).
intangibleRouAsset.title: Intangible Rou Asset

discountRate.description: Per-period discount rate (implicit or incremental borrowing rate).
discountRate.title: Discount Rate

singleModel.description: Whether the lease is on the single financing model (GASB 87, no operating-vs-capital split).
singleModel.title: Single Model

leases.title: Leases

sbitas.description: Subscription-based IT arrangements (GASB 96): recognize a subscription liability at present value and an intangible right-to-use subscription asset; SBITAs with a maximum term of 12 months or less are excluded.

maxTermMonths.description: Maximum possible subscription term in months (<=12 invokes the short-term exception).
maxTermMonths.title: Max Term Months

subscriptionLiability.description: Recognized subscription liability at present value (0 for short-term).
subscriptionLiability.title: Subscription Liability

rightOfUseAsset.description: Recognized right-to-use subscription asset (0 for short-term).
rightOfUseAsset.title: Right Of Use Asset

intangibleRouAsset.description: Whether the right-to-use asset is recognized as an intangible capital asset.
intangibleRouAsset.title: Intangible Rou Asset

sbitas.title: Sbitas

governmentWideStatements.description: Whether government-wide financial statements are presented (GASB 34 dual model).
governmentWideStatements.title: Government Wide Statements

fundStatements.description: Whether fund financial statements are presented (GASB 34 dual model).
fundStatements.title: Fund Statements

govWideMeasurementFocus.description: Measurement focus of the government-wide statements (GASB 34).
govWideMeasurementFocus.title: Gov Wide Measurement Focus

govWideBasis.description: Basis of accounting of the government-wide statements (GASB 34).
govWideBasis.title: Gov Wide Basis

govWideColumns.description: Activity columns of the government-wide statements (GASB 34): governmental and businessType.
govWideColumns.title: Gov Wide Columns

mdaPresent.description: Whether Management's Discussion and Analysis is present (GASB 34 RSI).
mdaPresent.title: Mda Present

mdaPlacement.description: Placement of the MD&A relative to the basic financial statements (GASB 34).
mdaPlacement.title: Mda Placement

govFundsMeasurementFocus.description: Measurement focus of the governmental funds (GASB 34).
govFundsMeasurementFocus.title: Gov Funds Measurement Focus

govFundsBasis.description: Basis of accounting of the governmental funds (GASB 34).
govFundsBasis.title: Gov Funds Basis

funds.description: Funds and their major-fund determination (GASB 34): the general fund is always major; any other fund is major iff an element is at least 10% of its category total and at least 5% of the combined total.

isGeneralFund.description: Whether this is the general fund (always major).
isGeneralFund.title: Is General Fund

categoryPercent.description: The element as a percentage of its category total.
categoryPercent.title: Category Percent

combinedPercent.description: The element as a percentage of the combined governmental + enterprise total.
combinedPercent.title: Combined Percent

funds.title: Funds

fundBalanceClassifications.description: The five GASB 54 governmental fund-balance classifications: nonspendable, restricted, committed, assigned, unassigned.
fundBalanceClassifications.title: Fund Balance Classifications

fiduciaryFunds.description: Fiduciary funds reported under the four GASB 84 fund types: pensionTrust, investmentTrust, privatePurposeTrust, custodial.
fiduciaryFunds.title: Fiduciary Funds

budgetaryComparison.description: The GASB 103 budgetary-comparison RSI: presented as required supplementary information with separate variance columns and notes explaining significant variances.

presentedAsRsi.description: Whether presented as required supplementary information.
presentedAsRsi.title: Presented As Rsi

budgetaryComparison.title: Budgetary Comparison

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Public Sector Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
